title: John Paul and Lily go on telepathic dates from different floors

tellings.quote: well often they'll be on different floors of the house and but they're communicating

plain: Two young people named John Paul and Lily go on "dates" in Atlanta in 2023 while staying on different floors of a house, and they communicate by telepathy, meaning mind to mind, without speaking. The filmmaker Ky Dickens, who made a documentary about nonverbal autistic people said to be telepathic, relays this from what she was told, including by a woman named Libby. If true, it would mean these two can talk across a house with no words at all.
